definition: Sum of consumption across all recovered and documented billing periods
limitations: Represents documented periods only and not continuous historical consumption

definition: Arithmetic average of consumption across documented billing periods
limitations: Not a monthly or annual average; period coverage is incomplete

definition: Number of calendar days between the start and end reading dates
limitations: Uses the recorded reading dates; does not establish equal calendar-month durations

definition: Average daily consumption within each documented reading period
limitations: An average rate for the reading interval and not a daily meter measurement

definition: Overall daily consumption rate weighted by documented reading duration
limitations: Applies only to documented reading intervals and does not fill chronological gaps

definition: Highest calculated daily consumption rate among documented periods
limitations: Identifies an observed maximum but does not explain its cause

definition: Lowest calculated daily consumption rate among documented periods
limitations: Identifies an observed minimum and may reflect period-specific conditions not documented here

definition: Number of unique billing periods represented in the consumption dataset
limitations: Counts recovered records and does not measure completeness against all periods that should exist

definition: Number of gaps detected between consecutive documented reading intervals
limitations: A gap indicates missing documentary coverage and does not establish whether consumption records existed elsewhere

definition: Number of unique periods with completed targeted invoice-level consumption verification
limitations: Five selected periods were checked; this is not a complete re-audit of all documented periods

definition: Share of documented consumption periods included in the targeted invoice-level verification
calculation: verified documented periods / total documented consumption periods * 100
limitations: Targeted selection is not a random sample and must not be interpreted as a general accuracy rate

definition: Comparable energy-only cost per kWh after tariff component reconciliation
calculation: Requires validated energy-only charges and corresponding consumption
limitations: Invoice amounts may include fixed charges subsidies taxes and other levies; no normalized series is currently supported
